tagline: An archipelago of regenerative luxury — built for silent, zero-emission island-hopping.
summary: Red Sea Global spans The Red Sea destination and AMAALA — dozens of islands and coastal resorts across a protected reef environment, anchored at hubs like Shura. The brand promise is regenerative and low-carbon, which makes silent, zero-emission foiling the natural guest-mobility layer: Pioneer II for inter-island hops, Quanta-LR to connect to NEOM and the Jeddah gateway.

use_cases.title: Signature island-hopping fleet
use_cases.body: Silent, zero-emission Pioneer II hops between the hub and the resort islands — the on-water arrival experience the brand requires.

use_cases.title: Reef-gentle excursions
use_cases.body: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: low wake, near-silent, smooth in chop — ideal for a protected reef destination.

use_cases.title: Luxury corridor connectivity
use_cases.body: Quanta-LR links the destination to NEOM and Jeddah as single smooth legs — one continuous luxury chain.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Silent, zero-emission inter-island hops over protected reef, with no charging infrastructure beyond a berth pedestal — the regenerative-by-design mobility layer.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Connects Red Sea Global to NEOM (Sindalah) and the Jeddah gateway as single hybrid legs with no charging-infrastructure dependency — stitching the Saudi Red Sea luxury chain together.

signature_routes: Red Sea Global ↔ NEOM / Sindalah (luxury corridor)
Shura hub ↔ resort islands (silent all-electric network)
transit_planning: For the destination operator: a silent, zero-emission guest-mobility network that matches the regenerative brand, scales from hub-shuttle to destination-wide mesh, and extends by hybrid range into a connected Saudi Red Sea chain.

red-sea-global.note: The on-water signature experience: silent foiling arrivals, reef-gentle, brand-aligned.
